title: Pin leave-then-resolve: a grid weight committed by leaving the cell, its save resolving after the blur, must not also fire rested()
evidence: From PR 1579 review R1. widget-src/src/components/StartingInfoVitals.tsx: rested() is called only from advanceToRest (line 307 on claude/confirmed-values); commit() (lines 389-414, run on leave by useSaveOnLeave at line 417) awaits onSave, then settle() and setActiveCell(null). That a leave-commit whose save resolves after the blur does not also call rested() is reasoned from code only. Add a test that holds onSave open, blurs the cell, resolves the save and asserts rested was never called. (H96)
